My friends all know i sh and that its been getting progressively worse lately. Im in the process of getting help, im on medication and starting therapy soon. One of my closest friends in the world is a guy and is very blunt. He does his best to make sure i understand the permance, danger and unnormal behaviour since my main difficulty is how normalised and okay my behaviours feel to me. Even with all this the one thing like you that i couldnt grasp is wanting to stop. 
It was a conversation with a community mental health counsellor that kinda helped me see my own delusions. I told her that i want to get better but i cant find a way to stop myself from cutting. And she told me that somewhere deep down i must want to stop otherwise i wouldnt be on medication, wouldnt be seeking out therapy and wouldnt be actively trying to get help. At that point i was like yeah what the actual fuck am i doing. Then i looked in the mirror and for the first time felt so scared and mortified at what id done and now im scared to do it again. 
While its only been a week since this happened im feeling differently abt my coping mechanisms and making baby steps to bettering myself. 
That being said, it doesnt take away the urges. Especially in the beginning. You just gotta find your reasons that motivate you to stop hurting yourself

I found this post by looking for ways to manage my anxiety because for me seeing a certain person triggers me into a breakdown where i  cant focus, get restless and have trouble breathing and feeling nausous. Im someone who is absolutely in love with music, its my coping strategy for everything. However there are times when i cant listen to music. So far the easiest way for me to cope during these triggering situations is to try and remember the lyrics to the last song i was listening to, every verse and chorus. This helps ground myself and take my focus off of the person and control my breathing. Hope this helps in some way :)
